sentences.text: Pompeii was an ancient Roman town-city near modern Naples , in the Campania region of Italy , in the territory of the comune of Pompei .	Pompei	Pompei	Campania	Campania	Italy	Italy	ancient Roman	Ancient Rome	Naples	Naples	comune	comune

Pompeii , along with Herculaneum and many villas in the suzrrounding area , was mostly destroyed and buried under 4 to of volcanic ash and pumice in the eruption of Mount Vesuvius in 79 AD .	Herculaneum	Herculaneum	volcanic ash	volcanic ash	pumice	pumice	eruption	Eruption of Mount Vesuvius in 79	Mount Vesuvius	Mount Vesuvius
Researchers believe that the town was founded in the seventh or sixth century BC by the Osci or Oscans .	Osci	Osci

It came under the domination of Rome in the 4th century BC , and was conquered and became a Roman colony in 80 BC after it joined an unsuccessful rebellion against the Roman Republic .	Roman Republic	Roman Republic

By the time of its destruction , 160 years later , its population was estimated at 11,000 people , and the city had a complex water system , an amphitheatre , gymnasium , and a port .	amphitheatre	amphitheatre	gymnasium	Gymnasium (ancient Greece)
The eruption destroyed the city , killing its inhabitants and burying it under tons of ash .	eruption	Eruption of Mount Vesuvius in 79

Evidence for the destruction originally came from a surviving letter by Pliny the Younger , who saw the eruption from a distance and described the death of his uncle Pliny the Elder , an admiral of the Roman fleet , who tried to rescue citizens .	eruption	Eruption of Mount Vesuvius in 79	Pliny the Younger	Pliny the Younger	Pliny the Elder	Pliny the Elder

The site was lost for about 1,500 years until its initial rediscovery in 1599 and broader rediscovery almost 150 years later by Spanish engineer Rocque Joaquin de Alcubierre in 1748 .	Rocque Joaquin de Alcubierre	Rocque Joaquin de Alcubierre
The objects that lay beneath the city have been preserved for more than a millennium because of the long lack of air and moisture .
These artifacts provide an extraordinarily detailed insight into the life of a city during the Pax Romana .	Pax Romana	Pax Romana
During the excavation , plaster was used to fill in the voids in the ash layers that once held human bodies .
This allowed archaeologists to see the exact position the person was in when he or she died .
Pompeii has been a tourist destination for over 250 years .

Today it has UNESCO World Heritage Site status and is one of the most popular tourist attractions in Italy , with approximately 2.5 million visitors every year .	Italy	Italy	UNESCO	UNESCO	World Heritage Site	World Heritage Site
